## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design tenant-isolated envelope encryption with Transit, policies, and AppRole lifecycle, plus rotation and decommission without downtime.

## Key Concepts
- Vault Transit per-tenant keys and namespace isolation
- Fine-grained policies for transit/encrypt/decrypt paths
- AppRole scoping and lease lifetimes
- Key rotation, data rewrap, and audit validation

## Code Example
```bash
# Create transit and per-tenant key
vault secrets enable transit
vault write transit/keys/tenant-T-enc

# Policy for tenant access
vault policy write tenant-T-policy -<<EOF
path 'transit/encrypt/tenant-T-enc' { capabilities = ['update'] }
path 'transit/decrypt/tenant-T-enc' { capabilities = ['update'] }
path 'transit/keys/tenant-T-enc' { capabilities = ['read'] }
EOF

# AppRole for tenant
vault write auth/approle/role/tenant-T --policies="tenant-T-policy" --token_ttl=7200 --token_max_ttl=7200
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test rotation impact on in-flight encryptions?
- How to extend for cross-region DR with replication?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical PKI setup, per-tenant isolation, and lifecycle in Vault, focusing on beginner-level configuration and safe offboarding.

## Key Concepts

- Vault PKI engine per-namespace setup
- Tenant-scoped roles and constraints
- Short TTLs and revocation paths
- Offboarding and audit considerations

## Code Example

```bash
# Mount PKI for a tenant
vault secrets enable -path=pki/ns/tenant-<id> pki
# Configure issuing and CRL points (example values)
vault write pki/ns/tenant-<id>/config/urls issuing_certificates="https://vault.example.com:8200/v1/pki/ns/tenant-<id>/ca" crl_distribution_points="https://vault.example.com:8200/v1/pki/ns/tenant-<id>/crl"
# Create role for tenant client certs
vault write pki/ns/tenant-<id>/roles/tenant-<id>-client allow_subdomains=true allowed_domains=tenant-<id>.example.com ttl=10m max_ttl=30m
# Issue a cert
vault write pki/ns/tenant-<id>/issue/tenant-<id>-client common_name=tenant-<id>.service.api.example.com
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you automate per-tenant revocation upon offboarding?
- What checks would you add to validate cert issuance policies?
